description: A React-like component defined using LightningJS Blits framework that renders a Product Card with image, name, and price, and updates based on 'item' prop changes.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A component class representing a product card with image, name, and price, that updates dynamically based on a provided 'item' object.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and sets up watcher for 'item' property.

methods.name: watchers.item
methods.description: Reactive watcher that updates component's display properties when 'item' prop changes.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles user input (e.g., enter key) to navigate to product detail page.
